_comment: The single grammar spec for the resolved-CSS-length -> raw pixel number conversion done by pxFromLength (src/token-controls/helpers/px-from-length.js) and, through it, tokenPx. The test asserts tokenPx(length) === px for each pair and null for every 'unconvertible' entry. A 16px root font size is assumed for rem/em -- the same assumption an unstyled rem makes in a browser. Note what is deliberately unconvertible: a UNITLESS value (including a bare '0', which CSS accepts as a length) has no unit to convert from. Inputs are canonical and carry no surrounding whitespace.
